rows.note: Use BB as the all-purpose casual word for a human baby, and also for a pet or romantic partner when the context is clear.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bi1 bi1 fan3 gan2 gaau3

rows.note: Use 大細路 for an adult or other person who behaves childishly rather than for an actual infant.

example.english: You're so grown-up, so why are you still such a baby?
example.traditional: 你都咁大個人，仲咁大細路㗎？
example.jyutping: nei5 dou1 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4 zung6 gam3 daai6 sai3 lou6 gaa3

rows.note: Use 新手 for someone who is new to or inexperienced in an activity or profession.

example.english: I'm still a baby when it comes to driving, so go easy on me.
example.traditional: 我揸車仲係新手，你慢啲啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zaa1 ce1 zung6 hai6 san1 sau2 nei5 maan6 di1 laa1

rows.note: Use 最細嗰個 when identifying the youngest child or lastborn in a family without implying a gender.

example.english: I'm the baby of the family.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 uk1 kei2 zeoi3 sai3 go2 go3
